annotations.title: Get a hired worker’s location map

description: Map data for one hired worker on a bounty that required precise location sharing, after the worker accepted it in the app: the job site and radius, the latest phone fix (lat/lng, accuracy in meters, capture time from the phone and receipt time from the server), the fixes recorded during the job newest first (up to 1000; `pointsTruncated` when more exist), and `gaps` where no fix arrived (never filled in). Sharing stops when the job ends (delivery, withdrawal, removal, cancellation or dispute), and nothing captured after that is shown; `session.preciseSharingEndedAt` is set when the worker stopped map sharing. Recorded fixes remain for review until deleted after 30 days. Use the location only to check attendance for this job. Returns 409 not_shared for workers who share on-site state only. Owner only.

sessionId.description: The attendance session ID (the hired application ID), from get_bounty_attendance
